media.position: centre of the front switch panel

sources.quote: ° ATARI Video Computer System Console Unit
Front Panel Power Game Program Game Reset Switch Slot Switch TV Type Switch Game Select Switch
Right Right Left Left Controller Difficulty Difficulty Controller
The Channel Switch is located on the back panel of the Console unit.
Insert the ATARI Game Program CAREFULLY into the slot in the center of the Console unit switch panel.
Hold the ATARI Game Program so that the name on the end is towards you and reads right side up.

notes: Envelope: Computer History Museum catalog 102730637, 'Atari 2600 Game Console', described by the record as 'an Atari 2600 video game console, four-switch wood veneer version, dating from ca. 1980-1982' (a bare console; no packaging named). The record does not print a model number; the four-switch wood-veneer console is the CX2600A the manual names, which is how the record is attached here. CHM labels the axes w, h, l: mapped w→width, h→height, l→depth. Values are the record's own centimetres ×10 (a decimal shift, no rounding of ours): 33.66 cm → 336.6, 10.8 cm → 108, 24.13 cm → 241.3. The record does not say whether projections (switch levers, feet) are included: excludes_projections null.
mass_g null: the record's weight is '4 (lb)', a whole-pound figure, which the lane never uses.

Manual: Atari 'Video Computer System Owner's Manual, Model CX2600A' (CO15394 Rev. 1, 1980, US), archive.org scan, OCR text layer; primary. A Rev. 2 scan (archive.org atari-video-computer-system-owners-manual-model-cx-2600-a-co-15394-rev.-2-1980-us-brown) shows the same FRONT PANEL / BACK PANEL captions with a back-panel 'POWER IN' and 'CHANNEL SELECTOR' legible.

controls: front panel per the manual's caption: Power, TV Type, Game Select, Game Reset (the last two momentary, 'Depress'); back panel: Right and Left Difficulty switches (caption 'Right Right Left Left / Controller Difficulty Difficulty Controller') and the Channel Switch. All filed as slide_switch, the contract's VCS-panel kind.
ports not filed: the back panel carries the Right and Left Controller jacks and the power jack, but the manual never names the connector types.
external_ids are the platform's: Wikidata Q206261 'Atari 2600' (API), igdb_platform from its P5795.
